page.notes: Lines with a printed hyphen at the line end are kept with the hyphen (confervatio-ne, conce-dat, legula-tor, praesen-tia, imitan-dus, necessa-ria). "Reges[?]" is a doubtful reading of the abbreviated word before "2.4."; "fatis[?]" is doubtful. The line "Potestatibus..." and "Potentia Regis..." are read as printed. The index is set in two lines per entry where the printer wrapped them, and each printed line is kept as one line.
